texts.aa7192ced605: To investigate the health of the use of ovarian stimulation treatment of infertility, with particular attention to ovarian cancer.  Flag study members who underwent fertility treatment, compare with a control group of untreated women determine whether these treated women have an increases risk of ovarian(and other) cancer.
